title: The showroom's start: what it is made of
caption: The start holds one thing: which demo is forward. Every part is told it, and says back what a visitor asked for, so the arrows and the buttons can't disagree.

holds.name: LitStage
holds.note: a light from above, in the forward demo's colour

holds.name: Deck<TItem>
holds.note: one item forward, the rest behind it in depth. Its Item slot is drawn for each demo:

holds.name: FramedWindow
holds.note: a bar like a browser's, then a body:

holds.name: the demo's own window
holds.note: the component the site names for the demo, drawn without the framework knowing what it is

holds.name: PlainBody
holds.note: when a demo names no window: its icon over its name and line

holds.name: Dock
holds.note: a button for each demo, the current one open to show its name

around.name: a site's page
around.heading: Who puts it on a page

around.name: ShowroomText
around.note: the words, a site's own or the English

around.name: ShowroomStart.razor.js
around.heading: Runs in the browser
around.note: puts the forward demo's address in the bar

around.name: Deck.razor.js
around.note: says which item a swipe left in the middle, brings the row to one, and leans the items to the mouse
